Subtree Value Updates and Queries

You are maintaining a corporate hierarchy tree with N nodes rooted at node 1. Each employee node is assigned an initial performance score. Your HR system needs to handle two types of operations efficiently:

Type 1: 1 u x — Add a bonus of x performance points to every employee in the subtree rooted at node u.

Type 2: 2 u — Query the total sum of all performance scores in the subtree rooted at node u.

Process all operations in order and print results for all type 2 queries.
explanation: Use Euler Tour (in-time/out-time DFS) to linearize the tree. After the Euler tour, the subtree of any node u is mapped to a contiguous range [tin[u], tout[u]] in the flat array. This transforms the problem into a Range Update + Range Sum query problem, solvable efficiently using BIT (Fenwick Tree with lazy range updates) or Segment Tree with lazy propagation. Operations run in O(log N) each.
